npcs.name: Old guy neighbour day 2
npcs.text: Good morning! I'm going to spend my day here I think. The sun is warm, the wind is calm and I have nothing else to do!
npcs.repeat_text: I'm glad the beach has reopened today, the great Sharpedo migration is an amazing sight to behold, if not a scary one. It'll be a long time before they're back.

npcs.name: Maintenance guy blocking forest
npcs.text: Sorry, the forest is closed off while we do some essential maintenance. We had even more wind than usual last night resulting in a lot of falling branches causing a safety hazard.
npcs.repeat_text: Sorry but it's going to take a least a day or maybe two. Once we've cleared all the loose branches and removed the fallen trees it'll be safe for people to enter again.

npcs.name: Car park guy 1
npcs.text: I'm the parking warden for the Celeste Harbour car park. Yesterday we had a massive issue with a biker gang meeting here in the car park, it was incredibly stressful!!
npcs.repeat_text: I'm glad the bikers finally left, everything is back to normal and my job is a lot easier now. The car park shuts at night so if you play the Pokemon TCG I'll be around for a game.

npcs.name: Policeman blocking beach day 2
npcs.text: All the Sharpedo are gone so it's safe to go to the beach again. I'm patrolling the area just to make sure.
npcs.repeat_text: I've been doing this job for long enough to know it's safe now but it's always good to show face for reassurance.

npcs.name: Man staring out to sea day 2
npcs.text: My girlfriend is out working at the juice bar today so I'm spending the morning running errands
npcs.repeat_text: If you go to buy some juice today say hello to my girlfriend for me.

npcs.name: Juicebar Woman (from staring out to sea)
npcs.text: Oh hey! I help run the juicebar a couple days a week, it's an easy job and at least I get to spend my day at the beach

npcs.name: Woman drinking juice
npcs.text: Mmmmmmmmmm............ Have you tried the juice here? Freshly squeezed, straight from the fruit and chilled to perfection.
npcs.repeat_text: ...... Nothing beats an ice cold delicious juice on the beach!

npcs.name: 2nd Woman drinking juice
npcs.text: I get the juice from here pretty much every day
npcs.repeat_text: I would be devastated if this place closed

npcs.name: Old Woman drinking juice
npcs.text: Sometimes you get a bonus coin as a little prize in the bottom of your cup
npcs.repeat_text: I normally find a prize coin after 2 or 3 cups

npcs.name: FisherMan drinking juice
npcs.text: Some days if we can't catch any fish we'll come here for a juice instead
npcs.repeat_text: You know what they say, you can take a fish to water but you can't make it drink!..... I think that's what they say?

npcs.name: FisherMan 2 drinking juice
npcs.text: Some days if we can't catch any fish we'll come here for a juice instead
npcs.repeat_text: You know what they say, you can take a fish to water but you can't make it drink!..... I think that's what they say?

npcs.name: Sailor working on dock
npcs.text: *huff* *huff* it's a hard graft looking after this dock. We don't have enough hard workers... Here, take this uniform. I have a lot spare because nobody wants to help out around here
npcs.repeat_text: We get a lot of ships come through, it's a really busy harbour

npcs.name: Super Elder 1
npcs.text: Hoh Hoh, I imagine you're new in town ey? We're the 3 Super Elders of the harbour. If you are able to win against us you can gain access to the Gym Hero Challenge.
npcs.repeat_text: You'll need some better cards if you have a hope of beating us. Come back in a few days when you're more ready.

opponents.name: Swimmer_Jordan
opponents.meet_text: I love the water, it's so calm and warm but my cards always get wet! I need to dry them off
opponents.rematch_text: I can always take a break for another match
opponents.rematch_win_text: Nothing like a good match and a long swim
opponents.loss_text: Maybe you should work on your swimming...

opponents.name: Firebreather_Darryl
opponents.meet_text: I've been breathing that much fire that I needed an ice cold bev to cool my mouth down, but I'm ready for a match if you want.
opponents.rematch_text: I'm fired up and ready for another match if you want.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I could teach you how to firebreath... but maybe you should teach me how to play cards better!
opponents.loss_text: That juice was just what I needed!

opponents.name: Firebreather_Kenneth
opponents.meet_text: I'm so used to hot drinks that it's weird to drink something nice and cold
opponents.rematch_text: If you want another match then let's goooooo
opponents.first_win_text: I have too many burns to battle well
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll just stick to the firebreathing from now on, I'm good at that.

opponents.name: Beach_Kid_Timothy
opponents.meet_text: I love the beach! I love the sand! I love building sandcastles! I love playing the Pokemon TCG!
opponents.rematch_text: I could build sandcastles and play Pokemon all day!
opponents.rematch_win_text: You can help me build a sandcastle if you want!

opponents.name: Beach_Kid_Evie
opponents.meet_text: I heard there's a scary Pokemon called Sandyghast. They sound scary and I don't like scary Pokemon, I only like cute pokemon!!
opponents.first_win_text: You haven't seen a Sandyghast have you?
opponents.rematch_win_text: If you see a Sandyghast please let me know!!

opponents.name: Swimmer_Todd
opponents.meet_text: I'm training for a Quadrathlon. It's a 1000m Swim, Bike, Run and then 100 TCG matches!
opponents.first_win_text: I can swim really well, maybe I should train using my deck more than swimming.
opponents.rematch_win_text: At least my swimming is going really well
opponents.loss_text: I am so ready for this event

opponents.name: Birdspotter_Tamsin
opponents.meet_text: These Palms attract a lot of Bird Pokemon so its a good spot to watch them
opponents.rematch_text: Looking for more Birds round here?
opponents.first_win_text: I wish I could just fly away.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You can't fly away from all your troubles
opponents.loss_text: You should try bird watching with me!

opponents.name: Bug_Catcher_Alex
opponents.meet_text: Some people hate bugs but I love them! Do you love bugs too?
opponents.rematch_text: You just love bugs as much as I do then?
opponents.first_win_text: Maybe bugs aren't as good as I thought...
opponents.rematch_win_text: Me and my bugs will win one of these days!
opponents.loss_text: I knew bugs were the best!!

opponents.name: Bug_Catcher_Johnny
opponents.meet_text: There are a lot of critters crawling around in these roots.
opponents.rematch_text: I've just seen a HUGE bug running around
opponents.first_win_text: I've got a lot of bug pokemon cards so you can take some
opponents.rematch_win_text: Let's have a bug catching contest!

opponents.name: Psychic_Brienne
opponents.meet_text: This dock is always so quiet, it's a great spot to meditate and to battle
opponents.rematch_text: I've been meditating a lot since our last match
opponents.first_win_text: I have to focus more. Take these cards to help you focus more too

opponents.name: Sailor_Bob
opponents.meet_text: We're preparing for the arrival of the SS Anne so there's not much to do until then
opponents.rematch_text: There's still time before the SS Anne arrives
opponents.first_win_text: I should at least pretend to do some work on the dock
opponents.rematch_win_text: I won't have a lot of time to play when the ship docks
opponents.loss_text: All this spare time has given me a chance to practice

opponents.name: Battlegirl_Sofia
opponents.meet_text: This beach is a great spot to train both my martial arts and my card skills
opponents.rematch_text: Want to join in with my training?
opponents.first_win_text: A loss is always a good chance to improve
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm going to keep on training
opponents.loss_text: I rarely lose when I've trained properly
